grounding.states: Mark Carney is the current prime minister of Canada
grounding.from: The 24th and current prime minister of Canada is Mark Carney

grounding.states: Carney took office in March 2025, after the Trudeau government collapsed
grounding.from: Britannica says he became prime minister in March 2025 after the government of Justin Trudeau collapsed.

value.answer: It's Mark Carney. He took office in March 2025, after Justin Trudeau's government collapsed, and nothing I found shows anyone else holding the job as of today.
